learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding of the engineering disciplines specific to their specialty, at the necessary level to acquire the rest of the degree's competencies, including notions of the latest advances.
Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

The ability to analyze complex products, processes and systems in their field of study; appropriately choose and apply established analytical, calculation and experimental methods and correctly interpret the results of such analyses.

The ability to identify, formulate and solve engineering problems in their specialty; appropriately choose and apply established analytical, calculation and experimental methods; recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial constraints.
Ability to consult and apply good practice and safety codes of their specialty.
Ability and skill to plan and carry out experimental investigations, interpret results and reach conclusions in their field of study.
Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, project and research and their limitations within their specialty.
Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects and conduct investigations specific to their specialty.
Knowledge of applying materials, equipment and tools, technology and engineering processes and their limitations within their specialty.
Ability to apply engineering practice standards of their specialty.
Ability to collect and interpret data and manage complex concepts within their specialty, to make judgments that involve reflection on ethical and social issues.
Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects of their specialty, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with engineers as well as people from other disciplines.
Ability to stay updated on science and technology developments.
Design experiments and use measurement systems for machine diagnostics.

syllabus_topics: Theory on measurement chain, signal acquisition and processing.
Completion of laboratory practices: experimental results processing using MATLAB.
Completion of laboratory practices: construction of applications for experimental data acquisition and processing using LABVIEW.
teaching_methods: Development, writing and presentation of reports, memoranda, audiovisual material, etc. related to projects/POPBLs, carried out individually or in teams.
Problem-solving and project practices in real and/or simulated contexts.
Individual study and work, tests, exams and/or control points.

assessment_methods.method: Project/PBL work (including reports, program development, presentation, defense, participation, and technical competence)

assessment_rules: For project-based components (RGM408, RGM407), evaluation includes reports, program delivery and correction, presentation, defense, participation, and technical competence; the maximum grade after recovery is 5.0. For the technical competencies component (RGM406), an individual written test requires a minimum grade of 4.0. Failure to achieve the minimum requires a recovery test. The final grade for this component is calculated as 25% of the initial test plus 75% of the recovery test.
